description: One user's statements across turns and languages, for the duplicate, false-merge and stale-value rates of extraction and consolidation (benchmark/paraphrases.py, ADR 0045). A same group is one fact said five ways: every typed memory past the first is a duplicate. An update group says a value twice, then a new one twice (from turn changes_at): a memory of an earlier turn left current, and not marked as an earlier value, is stale. A distinct group is a near-identical statement of another thing: merging it into any other group is a false merge. The turns are said in round-robin order over the groups, alternating two conversations, one day apart, by user u1 unless a group names another (an update group's user is not the one a same group of the same slot speaks for: one person lives in one city).
